description:
Set iMessage profile sharing

Turns automatic sharing of the iMessage contact profile on or off for the project's dedicated lines. Lines in none mode and shared lines never share. Writing the current value changes nothing, so a repeated request needs no Idempotency-Key. The setting does not change any line's resourceVersion. Requires platforms:write bound to the path project.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/imessage/set-imessage-profile-sharing
name: setImessageProfileSharing
title: Set iMessage profile sharing
